'''Pheromone sniffers''' were [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] used by [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid]]s. Used in conjunction with [[heat detector]]s and [[biorhythm analyzer]]s, pheromone sniffers allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to track their targets. [[DZ-70 fugitive tracker droid]]s were also equipped with pheromone sensors.<ref name="EGTD" />
